messages:
Erica Zhou: Morning async tick — quick roundup for SDKs / quickstarts / sampleapp. What I did: finished TypeScript SDK quickstart draft and pushed docs patch. Blockers: need one approval on docs PR and a sampleapp CI retry on mac M1. Today: will polish the TS snippets and prep a lightweight changelog. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/devex/pull/451 (docs) and https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-app/pull/452 (ci fix).

Samir Patel: Did yesterday: landed the sampleapp fix that unblocks mac packaging (PR 452). Blocker: the e2e run flakes on the M1 runner intermittently. Today: will run local M1 repro and try a CI matrix tweak (node 18 vs 20). @Lina Chen can you scan the quickstart wording in PR 451 later?

Miguel Torres: Did: prototyped node ESM entry for the SDK, minimal tests pass locally. Blocker: unclear distro packaging expectations (do we include prebuilt binaries or instruct users to pip/npminstall?). Today: plan to open a tiny RFC with options. Quick snippet I tried: ```js
import { RedwoodClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new RedwoodClient();
await c.embeddings(['hello world']);
```

Lina Chen: Will review PR 451 around lunchtime. Noted a couple of phrasing nits in quickstart (command ordering and alt text for screenshots). Also will add a small section on retry/backoff for sampleapp CI guidance.

DocsBot: CI status: sample-app PR 452 — mac-m1 job retried, currently queued. docs PR 451 — preview ready: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-451

Erica Zhou: Thanks team — @Samir please drop the local repro steps in the PR description if you get a solid repro. @Miguel RFC sounds good, tag me and I'll add packaging notes. I'll queue the changelog and release note once Lina's review lands. :thumbsup:

Samir Patel: Will add repro steps and post a short recording if I can reproduce.

Lina Chen: Quick FYI — found one broken screenshot link in PR 451, will fix in a follow-up commit.

Erica Zhou: Great — ping here when PRs are green and I'll merge the docs. If anything urgent pops up, drop a short message here instead of a full thread.
